body.purpose: All interface copy and prose. Use the platform sans stack by default; Inter is an opt-in packaged alternative.

label.purpose: Status tags, controls, chips, and captions at 600 weight.

mono.purpose: Code and terminal-born content. Use the platform mono stack by default; JetBrains Mono is opt-in.

motion.name: state-only
motion.value: transform and opacity only; no decorative motion
motion.purpose: Motion communicates state, remains interruptible, and is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

narrative.overview: Orc uses a restrained day and night swamp palette. Slate-neutral canvases and quiet moss surfaces keep content calm; neutral ink carries prose, blue marks interaction, and semantic color makes workflow state the loudest thing on screen.
keyCharacteristics: Two first-class Orc swamp themes: day and night, selected by system preference or explicit data-theme.
Flat, border-defined surfaces with tonal depth and no drop shadows.
Neutral ink carries prose; blue is reserved for active or interactive UI.
Semantic status color: green means pass, yellow warn, red fail, orange gate, purple lineage, and cyan informational data.
Compact editor-grade typography using platform fonts by default, with licensed Inter and JetBrains Mono available through an opt-in stylesheet.
Motion is limited to meaningful state and always respects reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Swamp Palette Rule
rules.body: UI colors come from the packaged Orc swamp tokens. Derived tints use color-mix instead of adding palette colors. First-party logo and icon artwork may compose palette hues but does not define UI token meaning.

rules.name: The Status Voice Rule
rules.body: Green means pass, yellow warn, red fail, orange gate, purple lineage, cyan informational data, and blue active or interactive. Every state also names itself in text so color is never the only signal.

rules.name: The AA Text Variant Rule
rules.body: Small colored text uses the dedicated --orc-*-text and --orc-muted-strong variants; raw hues remain available for fills, borders, and icons.

rules.name: The Opt-In Font Rule
rules.body: tokens.css uses platform sans and mono stacks. Consumers may import fonts.css to adopt the packaged Inter and JetBrains Mono files; components must work without that import.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use a border, panel background, or soft token tint for separation. Drop shadows are prohibited.

rules.name: The Reduced-Motion Rule
rules.body: Animate only meaningful state with transform or opacity, and provide a no-motion result under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

dos: Style system, explicit light, and explicit dark modes together.
Use native semantics, visible focus, accessible names, and text labels for state.
Verify contrast and responsive behavior at runtime in both themes.
Keep the package usable with its default platform fonts.
donts: Do not add gradients, marketing typography, decorative workflow diagrams, or drop shadows.
Do not use raw status hues for small text when a dedicated text variant exists.
Do not make webfonts or logo colors implicit global defaults.
Do not animate decorative details or ignore reduced-motion preferences.
